hero.headline: Same-day delivery for your shop, at a shared cost
hero.subhead: LocalLoop pools neighbourhood delivery routes so independent shops stop paying for half-empty trips.

problem: Small same-day deliveries cost more than the margin on the order.
Every shop runs its own half-empty route through the same streets.
It is hard to promise customers a delivery time you can keep.

offer.title: Shared routes
offer.body: Orders from nearby shops are planned into one route, so each trip carries more.

offer.title: Predictable cost
offer.body: A flat monthly subscription instead of a surprise bill for every trip.

offer.title: Simple for staff
offer.body: Add an order, hand over the parcel and the route plan does the rest.

how_it_works.title: Join your neighbourhood
how_it_works.body: Tell us your shop and delivery area. We group nearby shops together.

how_it_works.title: Add orders as they come
how_it_works.body: Enter each delivery. We combine them into planned routes.

how_it_works.title: Parcels go out together
how_it_works.body: A courier collects from several shops and delivers along one route.

proof.founder_story: LocalLoop is an early-stage idea from a founder who saw independent shops struggle with small same-day deliveries.
proof.process: We plan routes from the orders you enter and check early pilots with each shop before widening the service.
proof.guarantees: Join the waitlist for free. We will not charge you before launch and you can leave at any time.

faq.question: Is LocalLoop live yet?
faq.answer: Not yet. This page collects interest so we can decide where to start first.

faq.question: Will I be charged now?
faq.answer: No. The waitlist is free and we will tell you the final price before you commit.

faq.question: Which cities will you start in?
faq.answer: We will begin where several nearby shops sign up, so your interest helps choose the area.

faq.question: Do I need to change how I take orders?
faq.answer: No. You keep your current process and simply enter deliveries into LocalLoop.

cta.headline: Be among the first shops in your neighbourhood
